frame.description: Frame number, 0 is the first frame

tools.name: seekFrame
tools.description: Show the movie frame with this number (0 is the first)

tools.name: seekTime
tools.description: Move the movie to the frame nearest this time

tools.name: rotateView90
tools.description: Rotate the view 90 degrees about one axis of the screen

wait.description: Answer when every frame is loaded (default), when the first is shown, or at once

source.description: jp2: Helioviewer pictures over JPIP; fits-library: the HelioFITS Core cache on this computer

cadence_s.description: jp2 only: wanted spacing in seconds; omit for the server's default

dataset.description: jp2: the dataset as the server lists it, e.g. 'AIA 193' (with observatory); fits-library: a Core dataset key or uid

tools.name: layerAdd
tools.description: Add an image layer for a dataset over a time range and wait for its frames

tools.name: layerList
tools.description: The image layers in the scene, with their ids

tools.name: layerRemove
tools.description: Remove an image layer from the scene

tools.name: layerReload
tools.description: Read a layer's frames again; a FITS library layer queries the cache afresh, so files added since are picked up

filter.description: The filter; with chain, the first of them, at full strength

chain.description: Filters applied after filter, in series, replacing any chain the layer has; [] clears it. Each stage mixes its output with its input: (1 - strength) * input + strength * filtered. At most 3 filters in all, filter included (the jhv.filterChain.maxStages setting, 2 to 4). Ignored when filter is none.

params.description: The layer's image parameters by the names a saved session uses: clippingMode, clippingMin, clippingMax, scalingMode, gamma, beta, alpha, plane, subtractBackground, and the display settings

tools.name: filterSet
tools.description: Set a layer's image filter (optionally chained with more filters, each with a strength) and its FITS display parameters

zoom.description: Zoom by this factor, above 1 closer

warp_lambda.description: Box-Cox radial lambda of the helioradial projections

tools.name: viewSet
tools.description: Set the view: projection, zoom, Box-Cox lambda, tracking, corona

tools.name: viewGet
tools.description: The current view

frame.description: Frame number, 0 is the first; default the frame on screen

tools.name: frameGet
tools.description: Write one FITS frame's decoded values, as the layer shows them before any colour table, to an hf-decode-dump/1 document and return its path

long_side.description: Pixels on the long side; omit for the export size in the settings

tools.name: previewRender
tools.description: Render the scene as an export would, to a PNG in Studio's cache (not among the exports), and return its path

range.description: A movie record: load every frame, not the one checked

window.description: Where to load it; a record defaults to new, anything else to this

tools.name: sessionLoad
tools.description: Load a scene from a session file (.jhv), a session data archive (.data.zip) or an export's processing record (.hfrec); a record opens in a new window by default and checks its picture against the record's, one frame of a movie unless range

long_side.description: Pixels on the long side; omit for the export size in the settings

bundle_data.description: Write the local source files beside the export as <export>.data.zip (a still: its frames and what they depend on; a movie: the layers' files). Omit to follow Bundle source data with export in the Record panel

tools.name: exportStill
tools.description: Export the frame on screen as a PNG, with its processing record beside it

long_side.description: Pixels on the long side; omit for the export size in the settings

bundle_data.description: Write the local source files beside the export as <export>.data.zip (a still: its frames and what they depend on; a movie: the layers' files). Omit to follow Bundle source data with export in the Record panel

tools.name: exportMovie
tools.description: Export one loop of the loaded frames as a movie in the format the settings choose, with its processing record beside it

observer.description: A SPICE observer such as EARTH, SOHO, STEREO AHEAD, SOLO or PSP; omit for the active image layer's own observer

time.description: UTC time, ISO 8601; omit for the active image layer's frame (or the displayed time when no layer is loaded)

tools.name: identifyAt
tools.description: Name the Sun, Moon and planets at a helioprojective direction, as an observer sees them

observer.description: A SPICE observer such as EARTH, SOHO, STEREO AHEAD, SOLO or PSP; omit for the active image layer's own observer

time.description: UTC time, ISO 8601; omit for the active image layer's frame (or the displayed time when no layer is loaded)

body.description: Sun, Mercury, Venus, Earth, Moon, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune or Pluto

tools.name: identifyLocate
tools.description: Where a body is in an observer's sky: helioprojective Tx and Ty, distance, elongation, and whether the active layer's field holds it

field.description: punch: a 46.08 degree half-width square; layer: the active image layer's own field; custom: inner_deg, outer_deg and half_width_deg. Default punch

step_minutes.description: Sampling step; edges are refined to a minute. Default 60

tools.name: identifyInField
tools.description: When each body is in a field of view over a time range, by body and by UTC day: find dates with or without the Moon

icon_color.description: #RRGGBB, used when the icon is not coloured by kind

tools.name: identifySet
tools.description: Turn the cursor identifier and its tooltip and stars on or off, and set its tolerances; answers with every setting

pinned.description: true pins, false unpins; omit to toggle

body.description: Sun, Mercury, Venus, Earth, Moon, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune or Pluto; omit to list

tools.name: identifyPin
tools.description: Pin a body's label to the view, or unpin it, or list the pins; pins follow their body and are saved with the session

since_seq.description: Return events after this one; 0 (the default) for all still held, up to 5000

limit.description: At most this many events; default 500

tools.name: activityLog
tools.description: Read Studio's activity record: commands from scripts and assistants with their answers and timings, downloads, disk, HelioFITS Core's output, memory changes and log lines, oldest first, after since_seq

light.description: Show only this kind of line; default all

tools.name: activityShow
tools.description: Open the Activity window, on one kind of line if light is given, so the person can watch what Studio does

tools.name: listCommands
tools.description: List every command: its id, what it does and what it changes

id.description: A command id or a control id, as listCommands or Help > Search Controls shows

tools.name: describeControl
tools.description: Say what a command or control is, where it is, its shortcut, and which tours and tips show it
